summary: TurboGen Ltd., an Israel-based microturbine combined heat and power developer listed on Nasdaq (TRBG) and TASE (TURB), furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 5, 2026 announcing a long-term agreement with an unnamed EU-based tier-one engineering and manufacturing provider for serial development and production of its proprietary 20kW systems. The LTA has an initial five-year term with automatic annual renewals and targets defense and civilian markets, marking a transition from prototype development toward commercialization. No financial terms, pricing, equity stake, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed; this is an ordinary commercial/supply contract, not a special situation.
